children: Katherine Stueland, an insider and Chief Executive Officer, reported sales of Class A common stock on September 16, 2026. The reported sales were executed as sell-to-cover transactions to satisfy tax withholding obligations and the prices reported are weighted averages. The transactions involved shares sold at weighted average prices of $94.258, $95.405, $96.9009, $98.27 and $98.995 per share across five transactions, totaling $1,025,012. Following the reported sales, the reporting person directly beneficially owned 115,476 shares of Class A common stock. The reporting person also held RSUs representing rights to receive up to 280,228 shares and options to purchase up to 107,610 shares, which vest according to their terms.
